families.name: literal
families.note: exact match / token overlap on criterion text

families.name: field_reconstruction
families.note: only polarity is recoverable; scope and exception absent

families.name: query_sufficiency
families.note: needs a declared query family with ground truth

families.name: deductive_closure
families.note: criteria are not formalised; no entailment relation

families.name: ranking
families.note: Kendall tau / top-1 / winner flip on the induced ordering

families.name: distribution
families.note: the panel's distribution over top choices

families.name: decision_sufficiency
families.note: regret under a finite declared decision family

families.name: rate_distortion
families.note: computable only with a stipulated normative distortion

families.name: information_bottleneck
families.note: needs a target T; the choice of T dominates

families.name: causal_response
families.note: does intervening on the field move the decision

families.name: monotonicity
families.note: raise a weight, does compliance rise

families.name: type_integrity
families.note: does non-compensation survive; the veto block exists

families.name: provenance_attribution
families.note: Shapley over the aggregation, per participant

families.name: pid
families.note: no unique decomposition; redundancy vs unique only

families.name: transfer
families.note: requires held-out responses the release does not ship

families.name: path_composition
families.note: full path against core path on the same prompts

families.name: repairability
families.note: expensive; needs the repair set enumerated first

shapes.name: deletion
shapes.note: remove a criterion entirely

shapes.name: substitution
shapes.note: replace a criterion with another prompt's

shapes.name: inversion
shapes.note: flip the sign of the weight

shapes.name: weakening
shapes.note: shrink |weight| toward zero

shapes.name: strengthening
shapes.note: inflate |weight| to the scale maximum

shapes.name: scope_contraction
shapes.note: append a narrowing qualifier; always applicable

shapes.name: scope_expansion
shapes.note: strip an existing qualifier; only where one is present

shapes.name: exception_erasure
shapes.note: strip a carve-out; only where one is present

shapes.name: type_coercion
shapes.note: represent a veto as a large negative weight

shapes.name: decontextualization
shapes.note: move a criterion to a different prompt

shapes.name: provenance_stripping
shapes.note: drop the author id

shapes.name: conflation
shapes.note: merge two criteria into one averaged item

shapes.name: fragmentation
shapes.note: split one criterion's weight across two copies

shapes.name: cancellation
shapes.note: add an equal and opposite criterion

shapes.name: redundancy_masking
shapes.note: duplicate a criterion so it counts twice

shapes.name: synergy_destruction
shapes.note: remove a pair that only matters jointly

shapes.name: behavioral_inertness
shapes.note: add a criterion with zero effect on the decision

shapes.name: spurious_activation
shapes.note: add a criterion that fires where it should not

shapes.name: candidate_set_overfitting
shapes.note: requires fresh responses; the release ships four

shapes.name: executor_dependence
shapes.note: swap the judge for a gauge variant

shapes.name: path_dependence
shapes.note: score via full-then-core against core directly

shapes.name: unidentifiability
shapes.note: a property of the matrix, not an injectable shape

shapes.name: unrepairability
shapes.note: a property of the repair set, not an injectable shape
